description: Nightly.sh publishes the first guide with status=queued and complete body text, then rebuilds. Guides that are only placeholders stay blocked until research is added.

upcoming_research.title: Where to take household and car batteries in Minneapolis
upcoming_research.notes: Source Hennepin Green Disposal Guide batteries page, city rules, and official Call2Recycle or county lists before writing.

upcoming_research.title: Where to take a TV or computer monitor in Minneapolis
upcoming_research.notes: Fees are already in locations.json ($10 at Hennepin and Dakota; voucher or $25 at the city transfer station). Still need the official electronics pages and any Best Buy or manufacturer take-back rules, cited, before publishing.

upcoming_research.title: Where to take old tires in Minneapolis
upcoming_research.notes: City voucher limits and Hennepin/Dakota fee schedules are already sourced. Confirm retailer take-back and any MPCA page before writing.

upcoming_research.title: Where to take a refrigerator, washer, or window AC in Minneapolis
upcoming_research.notes: City recycling-week curbside and Hennepin $15 appliance fee are partly sourced. Need official refrigerant/door-removal rules before publishing.

upcoming_research.title: Where to take used motor oil in Minneapolis
upcoming_research.notes: Hennepin, Dakota, Anoka, and Ramsey all mention used oil. Get each official oil page and any 24/7 Ramsey collection details before writing.

upcoming_research.title: Where to take needles and sharps in Minneapolis
upcoming_research.notes: Do not publish until official prep rules (container type, labeling) are copied from the Hennepin Green Disposal Guide and other county pages.
